_comment: Numbeo 'Average Monthly Net Salary (After Tax)' read by hand (USD display) from city pages on the snapshot date. NYC is the anchor; the others calibrate it: salary_c = nycNet x k x PP_c/100 x colRent_c/100, k = median(published / uncalibrated). Numbeo's methodology page defines Local Purchasing Power against the COL-plus-rent basket.
_comment_basics: Numbeo 'estimated monthly costs for a single person ... excluding rent', hand-read the same day. basics_c = nycBasics x k x COL_c/100, k = median(published / uncalibrated). Used as a floor under the local salary where pay doesn't cover the basket.
